description: The Global Configuration keys the Integration Sidecar reads (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.5).

runtime_interface_range.description: The Node Runtime Interface versions the deployed Integration Sidecar supports: for each major, the highest minor it serves (architecture §2.3, §3.6.1). It comes with the Integration Sidecar, and its default is what the binary speaks.

preconditions.message: runtime_interface_range maps each major, a positive integer, to its highest minor (architecture §2.3)

embedding_model.description: The network's vector space: the egress_registry entry the Embedding Model is reached through, the model requested from it, its prefix convention and the longest text it accepts. It has no default: the network is born without a vector space (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.15).

entry.description: The egress_registry key of the Embedding Model.

model.description: The model requested from the entry.

document_prefix.description: The prefix of the capability_text side; empty in a model without prefixes.

query_prefix.description: The prefix of the task's text, the querying side (architecture §3.7.4); empty in a model without prefixes.

max_text_size.description: The longest text the model accepts, prefix included, in bytes of UTF-8; it stays out of the model_id (implementation §1.2.15).

preconditions.message: the network opens only with embedding_model assigned (architecture §2.3, §3.18)

cost_unit.description: The unit in which cost is denominated in data.metrics, and the rates of the egress_registry (architecture §2.3, §3.10).

egress_registry.description: The egress classes the network has authorized, one entry per key (architecture §3.16.2). What the schema does not express—the interface's format, and the conditions and billing_rule compiled against its fields—the binary checks (implementation §8).

interface.description: The operation interface the entry implements, copied whole, in the format of schemas/interface.schema.json (implementation §8.1).

protocol.description: The range of the deployed Integration Sidecar's adapters (implementation §1.2.12).

target.description: The destination: the root URL, http or https, every request resolves under.

operations.description: The operations of the interface the entry admits, declared explicitly.

grant_scope.description: Which nodes reach the entry; open when absent (architecture §3.16.3).

grantee_topics.description: The topics a topics entry reaches.

credential_handle.description: What the credential is resolved with in the Secret Store (architecture §3.16.6).

credential_placement.description: Where the credential goes in an https request: a header, with an optional scheme, or a query parameter (implementation §8.4).

rules.description: The ordered rules: the first whose when holds gives the outcome, allow, deny or an audience; the last carries no when (architecture §3.16.2).

billing_rule.description: Per admitted operation, the cost expression and the optional token expressions (implementation §8.5).

rate_source.description: The key of the rate table in the rates bucket; absent in an entry that costs nothing (implementation §8.5).

max_body_size.description: The largest body of a call and of its response, in bytes, when the interface declares any (architecture §3.16.2).

preconditions.message: a target is an http or https URL of a host, an optional port and an optional path, with no credentials, query or fragment (architecture §3.16.2)
a rate_source is a key of the rates bucket (implementation §8.5)
